title: RFC 8890: The Internet is for End Users
creator: Mark Nottingham

supports: The document argues that IETF work should favor human end-user interests when those interests conflict with other parties.
It explicitly warns that deployment size, bandwidth, latency, and user counts are not adequate measures of Internet success on their own.

title: Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage
creator: UNESCO General Conference

supports: The convention defines intangible heritage as practices and knowledge that communities recognize as part of their heritage and continually recreate.
Its definition of safeguarding includes identification, documentation, protection, transmission, and revitalization.

title: Measuring science and innovation for sustainable growth
creator: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

supports: The report discusses Goodhart's Law and the incentive to manipulate indicators once they are treated as targets.
It argues for measurement systems that remain attentive to the purpose and possible distortion of indicators.
